title: Demon Slayer
source: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba manga by Koyoharu Gotouge (205 chapters), to Muzan's defeat. The modern-day epilogue about descendants is not used.
world: Taisho-era Japan, where man-eating demons hunt at night and the secret Demon Slayer Corps hunts them back. After demons kill his family and turn his sister Nezuko into a demon, kind-hearted Tanjiro Kamado joins the Corps to save her. The strongest swordsmen, the Hashira, lead the fight against Muzan Kibutsuji, the first demon. Gentle family warmth set against tragic battles.
power_system: Demon slayers use Breathing Styles (Water, Flame, Thunder, Beast, Insect and more) with Nichirin swords that change colour; only sunlight or a Nichirin blade to the neck kills a demon. Demons regenerate and have Blood Demon Arts; the Twelve Kizuki are Muzan's strongest. Demon Slayer Marks boost a fighter's power.

timeline.summary: Tanjiro trains with Urokodaki and passes the selection.
Fight with Rui; Tanjiro meets the Hashira.
Rengoku dies protecting everyone from Akaza.
Tengen, Tanjiro, Zenitsu and Inosuke defeat the Upper Six.
Shinobu dies fighting Doma; the Corps defeats Muzan at dawn; Nezuko becomes human again.
